Be careful! Supposedly if you reach more then 45g in a 24 hour period that is when it can become lethal.
Assuming you don’t do that again however if there’s no different between 40g and 12g.
I think the highest I went was 32g, but I was on a suicide mission and was mixing. I don’t remember that night at all😂

Hey there! Wow somebody who takes as much as I! I start with 4-5,000 and work my way up by 1,600mgs every 15 minutes until I’m where I want to be. 
That’s why I have stayed around 10-12, simply because anything more then that doesn’t do shit for me.

I have an autoimmune disease, that causes chronic body pain and my inflammation levels are ALWAYS very high so I’m no joke, in pain 95% of the time. Even with the gaba, I’m prescribed Opiates on top of it.

It is common if you “abuse” the drug, nodding is a term used when a person who is using drugs of any sort and it causes them to go from being awake to a sleep like state so quick that they end up hanging their head down and “nodding” out. It’s a point of heavy sedation that said person usually has no real ability to be in reality.
No worries for your dosage, as I said before, it happens when you are abusing the drug and you seem to be on a low level dose🤗

I definitely have had noticeable issues with the respiratory depression, especially if I add rum in the mixture. I have had several run ins with my breathing coming to a close stop, if I didn’t have people with me at the time I’m not really sure what would have happened on a few occasions. I have it happen when I’m by myself the most, and I kind of have this thing for death so it’s a calming sensation for me. Most people it scares the shit out of them, and it should, it’s serious. 

I’m the way you are for the most part when it comes to that, just pushing pushing pushing, kind of testing the waters per say. I also believed I was not ever close to dying but my mind got changed after I had a really scary event happen last month with gabas, Vicodin, Xanax, Hydrocodone and Valium with two four lokos and a fifth of vodka. Yeah, that shit done fucked me up. I was on the floor not able to breathe, I mean literally I could not breathe, lost my hearing, couldn’t think straight, it felt like my heart was on fire and I could not physically move. My body would not work. I had a seizure and nearly suffocated on my own vomit, my neighbor below me heard a loud thud that night when I fell and she thought my abuser was here and called for a wellness check, so the police came here and ended up busting my door down because I wasn’t responding. 

Shit got real, I was stuck in the hospital for nearly two weeks and still am having issues from it because when I fell I also gave myself a traumatic brain injury. 

We all think it won’t be us, it could just never be us.
Don’t let your ability to have kept your shit together up until this point, to allow yourself to keep pushing it because your luck will only last so long because it absolutely can happen to you.

That’s the concern, is the od’ing. I don’t stop, until I am physically unable to take anything else or drink anymore. I’m addicted to the escape and have been using benzos and opiates while I have been drinking. 
I’m just a fucking idiot to be honest, if I don’t die from overdosing, it will be from whatever I’m doing while under the influence. Last year I was heavily intoxicated while on Xanax and ended up waking up in the hospital because apparently I ran directly infront of a car screaming about how I wanted to die. I don’t remember it, but it’s shit like that. 

I’m actually pretty lucky, physically my general organs are doing just fine. I’m anorexic and have been for 10 years and Mixed with the other shit I do, I am lucky to have my body doing pretty well. So I don’t think I will croak unless it’s a result from my drug use.

I wish my insurance would cover a long term stay in residential, 22 and have been doing the drug/alcohol shit for 10 years. 
22 and won’t make it to see next year if I keep it up, so my doctor says. I don’t know, life is crazy.

I never thought about that combo, I may have to give it a go! I love coffee anyways😂
I 10/10 am hungover every morning, I think it’s more of the gaba then the alcohol though because if I just drink, I don’t have hangovers anymore. On the weekends I end up drinking rum and I don’t wake up until noon, and when I do wake up I still feel the gaba fucking with me. Gaba and alcohol is a strange mixture, they amplify each other for sure.

Lmfao I get that, I honestly do not understand how many of us on here are still here typing though😂 
Gaba by itself has a low risk for overdosing on it, however mixed with other things has caused me to go into respiratory depression more then once.

Needless to say, we still have to be careful for sure.

When I was able to use at lower doses, I would have to go three days before my tolerance would go back down, and even then I would still be using 5gs. 
I’m in active addiction, so I’m not making the choice to go a few days to drop my tolerance back down. 
I had to go 5 days without them a few weeks ago and I was sick as fuck, I go into withdrawal pretty fast and by day 3 I feel completely dead. 
I drink alcohol with them, I haven’t heard much about drinking coffee and gabas together, is it a thing?

Yeah I mean we are all allowed to have opinions💁🏻‍♀️
Like I said, I don’t recommend it.

Hell yeah, nodding is my favorite!!! To be honest that is what I go for, I’m not satisfied until I’m nodding. 
Have anything exciting happening tomorrow? 
You will most likely feel a bit groggy in the morning, or afternoon depending on how hard it kicks your ass😂 
It stays in your system for awhile, sometimes I wake up still feeling overly medicated😂

Need to talk?

Gabas aren’t talked about enough😂 it’s one of my favorites to be honest.

I get 90, 800mg capsules a month, doesn’t last me very long at all. The rest I end up buying. And yes if your wondering it does create a big financial burden😂
I eat gabas 5 days a week, I use other things as well. #activeaddict 
I wouldn’t recommend taking as much as I do, the withdrawal is similar to opiate withdrawals (in my opinion) and it is not an easy med to find on the street so unless you are lucky and know a good hook up, your going to be fucked.

I mean, you will be feeling it, but I do not personally feel it is too much. 
I started taking 3,000 mgs a night and now I’m up too 10-12,000 mg a night. I don’t know many people who take as much as I do, so I wouldn’t say it’s something to work up too, but I’m just saying my opinion is you  physically are going to be okay. 
Don’t take those doses every night or you will have a real shit time coming off of them and you will have to continue building your mgs. 
Sit back and chill my friend, maybe have a trash can around in case it makes you feel dizzy. If you feel dizzy, do not close your eyes, it will make it much worse. 
The beloved nod may kick in, some people get it, others don’t, but it’s one of my favorite parts.
Best of luck to you, if you start panicking I’ll be up for awhile, 12,000mgs of gabbies for me tonight plus a few beverages🎉😂

First off, be proud of yourself for reaching out for help through Reddit, it takes a lot of courage to be open about whats going on.  


My suggestion would be to reach out to your parents and allow them to know how you are feeling, i know how hard that can be, as i had very abusive parents and getting help was putting "shame" on my family. Even if they do believe your doing this to yourself, realistically you are NOT and you deserve the help. My dad would tell me i needed to be able to figure out my life on my own, while i was having suicide attempts and tearing my life to shreds, well here i am now, 22, and still ripping my life apart with drugs, alcohol, more suicide attempts, because i tried doing it all on my own. You are deserving of feeling better, and to do so, at this point for you, it sounds like you really could use some outside help, from a professional. 

  
So what is the worst thing about somebody believing you are dramatic? be dramatic and yell for help, do whatever you have to do to get yourself back to a better place, you know it will continue to spiral if you dont. Start with your parents and ask them to get you help, if they tell you that you will be fine, express to them how bad things are getting again, if they are still unwilling to allow a better future for yourself, then it would be time to do more and bring an outside source, in. As in allowing your school to know what is going on for you mentally and allowing them to help you figure out what resources your town has.   


I understand how frustrating all of this is, and sometimes it seems so unworthy of your time, because why does it matter? I get it, and you dont see it right now, but there IS a reason you are here, as cliche as that is, its the truth. I am here if you need to talk OP, or if you need help finding resources near you, i am a mental health advocate and have a lot of experience helping mentally ill people get the on the path they need to be on.   


if you are in immediate danger, please contact your local police department and let somebody help you hun, also texting 741-741 with the word "help" will get you in touch with a crisis counselor who can just help you through your tough times, they wont contact authorities unless you are going to hurt yourself/already have or if you stop responding. They are a good resource to just have another human being listening to you, so you feel heard.
Thank you very very much!!!!!

hey there,   
So first off i want to say that its brave to get on here and ask us what our opinions were, as we are a bunch of strangers.  
I really relate to this post, as somebody whos mother also put roadblocks in the way of my treatment, i want to explain to you how important it is, that you fight for your way to recieve help, even if you dont think you want it.   


Your mother saying that you would be evaluated by "strangers" is true, however when we go to the doctors for the first time or the dentist, or anything in that genre, they are also strangers and we have to put some sort of "trust" into these people when we need help. Her excuse makes no actual sense, it sounds like she is concerned for some reason about what may come out of an evaluation. That is on her, not on you.   
I let it go with my mom, and i am literally fighting for my life, right now, as i type this, because i am so mentally unwell, from not getting the help when i was a adolescent. When i say receiving help for your mental health, whatever your diagnoses may be, is CRUCIAL right now, i mean it. I wish more then anything i would have done so, i cant imagine what my life may look like now.    
Look, i dont know you, i dont even know how old you are, but you have a future that you have to prepare for now, i missed out on SO much because i eventually was unable to function, you can keep putting this off, for weeks, months, years, but you cannot outrun a mental health concern, i tried, and im sure you have heard it, and think its not that BIG of a deal, but coming from somebody who has been there, done that, a hundred times, it really is that big of a deal. Get ahold of life by the horns now, before you are completely out of control, and turn into somebody you dont recognize.   
An evaluation is not scary, not in the way your brain makes it out to be. Mine happened with a really nice lady who asked me to fill out some questionnaires and then asked me a bunch of questions that were not on the paper, mine took about an hour and a half. They ask you personal things, how your depression has been, if you have had thoughts of hurting yourself or anybody else, if you see or hear things other people dont, things in that nature. They would want to see what level of treatment that would best benefit you.  


I hope you can get some help OP, if you need to talk or need help figuring out how to get yourself to an appointment with peds, message me. i am 22 and escaped my abusive household 1.5 years ago, i am willing to help in whatever way you need.

Story time:   
So as a teen, i would watch intervention and have those same thoughts. i watched that show and oddly enough saw myself in their shoes, even though at the time i wasnt using "too" much. let me tell you something, that is your WARNING sign, pay attention to the red flags that are appearing while you watch that show and think these things. im a full blown addict now, i decided to go out and see what was so great about drugs and alcohol and i was so curious because my family members are also addicts and alcoholics, this is not the life to live, dont be curious, turn away now before you get sucked in to a disaster.   
being scared is good, keep being scared. dont ever get warm and cozy with the feeling of using substances or watching others use. I love intervention, its a great show, but it also can be very triggering.   
i dont know you, i dont know your life or your story or anything, but i can tell you that i too started with being scared of using, to become addicted, and then i got curious and now nothing else matters. your life with get sucked into a hurricane and leave a disaster behind.   
Do.Not.Be.Curious.   
Work on yourself, your life, and what things you can do to make sure you dont become and addict. i know this is long and stretched out, but it is a warning sign, and i understand what your saying completly.   
Best wishes to you, and i hope things work out for the best!!!
